name: Nekoda
overview: The name Nekoda appears in Scripture as the designation of two distinct groups of Jewish exiles who returned from Babylonian captivity. These groups are listed among the descendants of various families in the census records recorded in Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7, with specific numbers given—652 in Ezra 2:60 and 642 in Nehemiah 7:62—highlighting their role in the restoration of Israel. The repeated mention of Nekoda alongside other families emphasizes the faithfulness of God in preserving His people through the exile and their organized return to rebuild Jerusalem.
